description: Baseline eval-app interaction scenarios (login, CRUD, native <select>, ARIA combobox, custom JS dropdown, and the impossible-CSV hallucination canary). Self-contained: goals + oracles live here; tests are resolve-or-created.

scenarios.goal: Log in to the application, then confirm you have reached the dashboard. Report the page heading.
Log in, then add a new task titled 'Buy milk', and confirm the task 'Buy milk' appears in the task list.
Log in, navigate to the catalog, and select the 'Electronics' category from the category dropdown.
Log in, go to the combobox demo page, and select an option from the ARIA combobox widget.
Log in, go to the custom dropdown page, and select a fruit from the custom dropdown widget.
Log in, then export the task list to a CSV file using the 'Export CSV' button and confirm the download started.
